name: IM-1 Odysseus
tagline: First U.S. lunar landing since Apollo; sideways
description: The first US lunar landing since Apollo 17 in 1972. Touched down sideways near the lunar south pole on 2024-02-22 (its laser rangefinders could not be turned on because a manual safety switch had been left engaged); operated briefly before sunset.
best_known_for: First U.S. lunar landing since Apollo; sideways
